reviews.text: Karen was a tremendous help with my excitement reactive puppy! And a huge help to me. She offered sensible solutions and helped transform my sweet girl. I especially found her detailed follow up emails an asset. Highly recommend for anyone welcoming a new love to their home.
Karen was the best!  She provided useful tips and tricks through positive reinforcement to help us and our young children get acclimated to our 3 month old puppy.

Karen is an experienced trainer who helped my adopted dog overcome his longstanding aggression towards other dogs, which was becoming quite a problem. She offers practical solutions and is relaxed and easy to work with. She also helped me to see things from the dog’s point of view!

Karen is truly a dog whisperer. As a first-time dog owner, I needed someone who could teach me about dogs but specifically my puppy. Her intuition and ability to understand my puppy, his personality and behavior, was really impressive. She always seemed to know exactly what he wanted/needed.

Karen is patient, knowledgeable, encouraging, and explains everything in a way that’s easy to understand and apply at home. She gave me the tools with detailed write ups that included recommendations on supplies to train my pup, and the results have been pretty great. She has a training agenda but can easily pivot based on your needs such as a behavior that needs to be immediately addressed.

I highly recommend Karen to anyone looking for a skilled and compassionate dog trainer. To be clear, she isn’t training your dog, she is training you how to train your dog. It’s the owner that needs to do the training!

Karen is absolutely wonderful! She was referred to us by a friend who said she was the reason their dog is so well behaved—and now I completely understand why.
I have two Havapoos, Frankie and Zoe, and even though I grew up with dogs, I quickly realized that training two puppies at the same time required a completely different approach. Karen immediately understood that each dog needed their own strategy.
From the moment she walked in, the training began—and both dogs took to her right away. She has such a kind and gentle way about her, and the dogs naturally responded to her calm, confident energy. She was also incredibly patient and supportive with us, which made a huge difference in helping us stay consistent and work together effectively.
We saw a noticeable improvement within the first week after our first session, which was amazing. I really appreciate Karen’s continued support, and I feel confident knowing we can reach out if we need guidance.
If you’re looking for help training your dog, you’ll be in very good hands with Karen!
My dog was always happy to see Karen. He enjoyed pleasing her. Karen can teach you simple tricks to get your dog to behave

Karen is a wonderful trainer. My dogs have always loved her. She is patient while teaching us how best to train our pup. She is a strong believer in learning to get to know your pup and the best way to motivate them. She explains their behaviour to us and encourages us to use positive reinforcement. She points out the things we have done that are not helping us get the best out of our pup. I have used her help with all three of my dogs over the years. Strongly recommend!

Karen’s help was instrumental in establishing core commands and structure to help us with our new puppy.  As a first time dog owner she helped us understand how best to approach our dog for the best results.  Thanks Karen!

Karen was amazing at helping us train our sweet Goldendoodle, Lenny! She provided us with strategies that were easy to follow through with at home with our family. We loved getting her thorough follow up emails about everything that we had learned during our family training session.

Karen has been tremendously helpful and supportive in helping us train our puppy! Her approach is kind and compassionate while still enforcing boundaries and good habits. We couldn’t have trained our puppy without her help and expertise! We are so grateful to her!

Karen is very helpful with our puppy. We have learned a lot and have been able to implement a more structured routine with our furry baby. Our dog loves spending time with Karen and my daughters have benefited from the informative sessions

Karen from Healthy Houndz is great! I found her through a google search and reached out for a phone consultation. As soon as Karen stepped into our home the training started and it was very informative and helpful. One of the first things we addressed was sleeping and we saw results that same night! She helped us understand what our puppy was thinking and how to address the behaviours we were having issues with. After every session we felt more confident to train our puppy and have seen really great results!
Karen was amazing at training help with our pandemic puppy. We were so happy to have someone explain proper training and with so much patience. Highly recommend Healthy Houndz!
